# Templates

Copy one of these when starting a new document. Do not edit the templates in
place — copy them into the right folder and rename to `NNNN-short-slug.md`.

| Template | Use for | Goes into |
|----------|---------|-----------|
| [`frd.md`](frd.md) | Capturing functional requirements | [`../requirements/`](../requirements/) |
| [`technical-design.md`](technical-design.md) | Designing a feature/system before building | [`../designs/`](../designs/) |
| [`implementation-plan.md`](implementation-plan.md) | Planning the delivery of approved work | [`../plans/`](../plans/) |
| [`adr.md`](adr.md) | Recording a significant architectural decision | [`../adr/`](../adr/) |
